    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">可怕，看到一个冷血的算法。</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="nice" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" data-website="https://www.mdnice.com" style="margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; font-family: Optima, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, PingFangSC-regular, serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; word-spacing: 0; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left"><p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你好呀，我是歪歪。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最近 reddit 上有一篇匿名的帖子，火了，火得一塌糊涂。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">匿名者自爆身份说是国外某大型外卖应用的开发者，爆料了公司几个关于“压榨员工”的手段，以及一个叫做“绝望评分”的非常冷血的算法。
光是在 X 上的截图就获得了超过 3600 万次观看，然后无数人又拥进了 reddit 论坛的原贴中参观。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">其中就包括我。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这是原贴的地址：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">https://www.reddit.com/r/confession/comments/1q1mzej/im_a_developer_for_a_major_food_delivery_app_the/</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">下面的图片是帖子的完整内容，为了方便你阅读，我用沉浸式翻译插件把中文也给你翻译出来。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你可以大概瞅几眼，“触目惊心”的部分我下面会单独拿出来讲：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/740ca87be685d1a8f2ce16f3e45697e3.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不知道你看完之后的感受是什么，反正我就一句话：万恶的资本主义。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">标题其实就已经在爆料了：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">The 'Priority Fee' and 'Driver Benefit Fee' go 100% to the company. The driver sees $0 of it.<br>"优先费"和"司机福利费"全部归公司所有，司机一分钱都看不到。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">在美丽国的打车软件中，有"优先费"和"司机福利费"这两个东西。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">要更加深入的了解作者爆料的内容，得先站在美国的国情之下，去了解一下这两个东西到底是啥。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">于是我去问了一下 ChatGPT。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它是这样的给我解释的：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260106221137.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">什么是这个 Driver Benefit Fee 呢？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它虽然叫做“司机福利费”，但是并不会直接给司机。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而全部流入平台，给司机买福利用的，比如保险、医疗、合规成本。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这 $2.50 不会因为你这一单而直接多给司机，它全部进入了平台。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个“司机福利费”我觉得其实就是个文字游戏了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果它就明确叫做“小费”，是乘客主动在车费之外给司机的，那么平台把这个费用一点都给不司机，那确实该骂。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而这个“优先费”就更好理解了：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260106222139.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">也不会给司机，而是由于你付了费给平台，平台给你的订单赋予了更高的权重。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">站在司机的视角，他根本就不知道你这个单是优先订单。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">关于优先费，在帖子中，爆料者是这样描述的：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260106223110.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">“我们没有加快优先订单的速度，而是故意将非优先订单延迟 5 到 10 分钟，让作先订单通过对比显得“更快”。管理层非常满意这个结果。我们仅仅通过让标准服务变得更差，而不是让高级服务变得更好，就赚取了数百万的纯利润。”</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个让我莫名想到了这段著名的代码：
<img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/e36c994f27a61e89c32abbf4d95eba41.jpg" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%"></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">关于"优先费"和"司机福利费"的爆料其实我觉得并不炸裂。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">只能说美国自有它的国情在。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">炸裂的点在于它帖子中这几句描述：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260106223510.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这里提到一个“绝望评分"，从他的描述来看，也确实够绝望的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果一个司机通常在晚上 10 点登录并立即毫不犹豫地接受每单 3 美元的垃圾订单，算法会将其标记为“极度渴望”。一旦被标记，系统就会故意不再向他们展示高薪订单。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个背后的逻辑是：当我们知道他渴望到愿意用 6 美元来接单时，为什么要花 15 美元让这个人跑一趟？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">卧槽，这段描述看得我目瞪口呆。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">通过搜集司机行为，来评估一个人的缺钱程度。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">出同样的力，越缺钱的人，挣更少的钱？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">老舍先生当年写骆驼祥子的时候，也没有想到这个角度啊。</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260106224440.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我就问着玩意谁看了之后不骂上一句：万恶的资本主义？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">和窃取司机小费这件“小事”来说，我觉得“绝望评分”是这个匿名的帖子最劲爆的点，也是最能引发人们讨论的点，所以迅速就火起了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">大家在评论区各种义愤填膺：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107204715.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107204804.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107205024.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">也有人说应该向媒体爆料，借助媒体的力量将这些龌龊的事情公之于众：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107204919.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">除了上面这些声音外，还有人也提出了质疑：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107205316.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">怀疑这个帖子是 AI 写的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是有人为作者辩解说是作者特意让 AI 在不改变原意思的基础上加工一遍，最大可能的保护自己。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">反正大家在评论区众说纷纭吧。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不知道你看到这里的时候，你本能的想法是什么。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">反正我是相信这样的事情是存在的，这样的事情也是应该被曝光的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而记者又对这一类事情非常的感兴趣，一旦采访到匿名者，拿到实锤证据，这就是自带热搜体质的新闻。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">事实上，也真的有记者联系到了这位匿名者。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-top: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.1em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0 5px 0 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 3px 10px 1px; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">反转来了</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span><span style="border-bottom: 36px solid rgba(239, 235, 233, 1); align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-top: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 20px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0; line-height: 1.1em; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"> </span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">要不老话说，没有调查就没有发言权呢。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">当吃瓜网友在帖子里面讨论的热火朝天的时候，以为记者站了出来。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">扔出了这篇文章：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">https://www.platformer.news/fake-uber-eats-whisleblower-hoax-debunked/</p>
</blockquote>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107210707.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我看了一下这个哥们的来历，他写了很多关于揭露 AI 造假的文章，有一个叫做
Deepfakes 的专栏：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107211022.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">他在文章说他是一个非常想要拿到独家报道的平台记者：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107212500.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是这个爆料者是匿名的，怎么办呢？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">他通过只能在 Reddit 平台上给爆料者发消息，表明自己的记者身份，并提供了自己的联系方式。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">然后，记者收到了对方回复的一条信息：我看到你在我的 Reddit 帖子中联系了我。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">相当于是双方建立了共同渠道。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而且记者也要到了爆料者的员工证：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107213154.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107213336.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果我是那个记者，我想我当时的心情一定是非常激动的：这么棒的报道，我马上就可以开始跟进了。这玩意一旦发出去，那杂志不得卖爆了？升职加薪，指日可待。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">然而，现实很快就泼了他一盆冷水。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为当记者向爆料者要一些证明材料的时候，出岔劈了：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107213557.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个工牌后面被证实是通过 Google Gemini 生成的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">更奇怪的是爆料者给他提供的一份材料：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107213756.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这份材料，记者也公布了出来：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/26456842-fake-reddit-post-whistleblower-document</p>
</blockquote>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107213920.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我把这个 PDF 给到 ChatGPT，这是它给我分析的文件内容：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107214303.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">还有最后的总结部分我必须得截图出来：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107225447.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">乍一看还是像模像样的，和爆料的内容完全匹配。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">一开始把记者也给唬住了：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107214513.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是记者越看越觉得不对劲：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107214606.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">与此同时，爆料者还在给记者施压，告诉他：他已经将文件分享给了其他记者。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这让记者陷入了竞争的困境，害怕发布晚了就不是首发了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">记者又问他能不能提供给他一些爆料者现在的或以前的同事信息，以帮助记者更好地理解这份文件。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是他直接回绝了：不能。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个时候，记者也开始犯嘀咕了：这不会是假的吧。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">于是他把工牌扔给了 Gemini，并询问 Gemini 是否制作了它：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107215330.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Gemini 给了他肯定的答案。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这里他也提到了一个小知识点：Gemini 能够检测到它生成的图像中嵌入的 SynthID 水印。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果有这个 SynthID 水印，就代表这是 Gemini 生成的。</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16722517</p>
</blockquote>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107215620.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">当记者去质问爆料人的时候，就没有后文了：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107215739.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">记者对于这件事情就非常的感慨，提出了关于“AI 之恶”的思考：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107220304.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107220823.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最后这句话值得单独列出来：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">you should always be at your most suspicious online when someone is baiting you into outrage.<br>当你被人引诱发怒时，你应当最为警惕。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你现在去看原贴，已经是被删除了：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107221210.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">算是彻底为这个闹剧画上了句号。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是原贴的浏览量几千万，证实它是假新闻的帖子却没有什么流量。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">造谣一张嘴，辟谣跑断腿。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">看来这句中国的老话，放在全世界的范围内也都能适用呀。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">其实本着看热闹不嫌事儿大的原则，我还脑补了另外一个场景：其实这个爆料人说的都是真的，但是他确实给不出实锤的证据，为了让记者报道引发更大的舆论，他才选择了伪证证据。最后舆论声势造起来了，有实锤证据的人走到台前和巨头公司正面硬刚。最终人民取得了胜利。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">就按照这个剧本，再来一个反转，刺激了。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-top: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.1em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0 5px 0 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 3px 10px 1px; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">写在最后</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span><span style="border-bottom: 36px solid rgba(239, 235, 233, 1); align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-top: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 20px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0; line-height: 1.1em; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"> </span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">写这篇文章的时候，我想起了几年前看过的一篇关于骑手的文章，我觉得这才是一篇有理有据，真实可信的好的调查类文章：<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Mes1RqIOdp48CMw4pXTwXw" style="color: rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); font-weight: bold; border-top: 1px none rgba(30, 107, 184, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(30, 107, 184, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(30, 107, 184, 1); border-radius: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-thickness: initial; overflow-wrap: break-word" rel="noopener nofollow">《外卖骑手，困在系统里》</a></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">（我依稀记得这篇文章的原名称是：《外卖骑手，困在算法里》）</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个文章里面也出现了大量的“算法”：</p>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107222418.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img src="https://why-image-1300252878.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/img/20220716/20260107222614.png" alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)"></figure>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而我对于文章中最后部分的这句话，可以说是记忆犹新：</p>
<blockquote class="custom-blockquote multiquote-1" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 20px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px solid rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(255, 249, 249, 1); width: auto; height: auto; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: auto"><span style="display: none; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"></span>
<p style="text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal; margin: 0">外卖员每跑一单的任何数据都会被上传到平台的云数据里，作为大数据的一部分。外卖员的劳动越来越快，也变相帮助系统增加了越来越多的『短时长数据』，数据是算法的基础，它会去训练算法，当算法发现原来大家都越来越快，它也会再次加速。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">值得说明的是，这篇文章是 2020 年写的，5 年过去了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">在我个人的感官里，对于外卖员的算法，并没有“再次加速”，而是加入了一些“人性”在里面。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这得益于平台、外卖员、顾客的共同努力。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它还是没有足够的好，还有很多的进步空间。但整体大的趋势是能感受到比几年前要好的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">写文章的时候我也扪心自问了一下，如果真的存在“绝望分数”这样的东西，真的要让我去写出这样的一套代码投入使用，我可能没有足够的勇气去曝光它，但是我可以做到的是我会选择离开做出这个产品的地方。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不是算法冷血，它只是忠实的执行了我们的欲望。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">人心逐利，算法只会更聪明地逐利。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但是人心向善，技术就会向善。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">与君共勉。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最后，欢迎关注公众号，why技术，全网首发。</p>
</section>
